title: Strengthen the evaluation design in 4.4
requirements:
- Replace attribution language with contribution-oriented wording and proportionate evaluation methods
- Require performance to be measured and published by a party other than the operator, with fixed definitions
- State the harmonised definitions and metadata needed before cross-country comparison
- Differentiate continuous operational, quarterly implementation, annual maturity and long-term outcome assessment
- Require documentation of baseline limitations and proxy indicators
- Define minimum process-evaluation dimensions
